Help

FAQ

How do I find my size?+
Each product page includes a detailed size guide. For personalized assistance, use our AI Stylist or reach out to our personal shopping team.
What is your return policy?+
We offer a 15-day return policy for unworn items with tags attached. Customized and sale items are final sale. Visit our Returns page for full details.
How long does shipping take?+
Standard delivery takes 5-7 business days. Express delivery (2-3 days) and next-day delivery are available at checkout for select pin codes.
Do you ship internationally?+
Yes, we ship to over 45 countries. International shipping rates and delivery times are calculated at checkout.
Can I get personal styling advice?+
Absolutely! Our AI Stylist is available 24/7 for instant recommendations. For deeper consultations, book a session with our human stylists via the Contact page.
Are the products authentic?+
Every piece is designed and manufactured in-house or by our certified artisan partners. We guarantee authenticity and provide certificates for fine jewelry.
How do I track my order?+
Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking link via email and SMS. You can also track orders in your account dashboard.
Do you offer gift wrapping?+
Yes, all orders come in our signature luxury packaging. Gift wrapping with a personalized note is available at checkout.
